 Nitto ATP Finals 
 Best Nitto ATP Finals Media Day photos through the years
 13 November 2026 
 By ATP Staff 
 © Clive Brunskill/Getty Images 
 The eight singles players competing at the 2018 Nitto ATP Finals take the tube in London. 
 Share:
 Look back at some of best moments from the past media days 
 The stage is set in Turin, where the world’s best players have arrived to compete at the Nitto ATP Finals.
 With Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton among those set to headline action this year at the season-ending championships, ATPTour.com looks back at some of the iconic photo shoots from the past.
 Be part of the action this fortnight in Turin and sign up here to ATP Unlocked for exclusive coverage in the Nitto ATP Finals Hub.
 L-R: Juan Carlos Ferrero, Lleyton Hewitt, Thomas Johansson, Carlos Moya, Jiri Novak and Marat Safin in Shanghai in 2002. Photo: LIU JIN / AFP via Getty Images. 
 The players line up at the Introduction Ceremony for the 2002 Tennis Masters Cup in Shanghai. Photo: Clive Brunskill/Getty Images. 
 L-R front row: Nikolay Davydenko, Roger Federer, Gaston Gaudio, Ivan Ljubicic; L-R back row: Guillermo Coria, Andre Agassi, David Nalbandian and Rafael Nadal in Shanghai in 2005. Photo: Clive Brunskill/Getty Images. 
 The singles [front row] and doubles competitors [back rows] in Shanghai in 2008. Photo: Matthew Stockman/Getty Images. 
 [L-R] Fernando Verdasco, Juan Martin del Potro, Novak Djokovic, Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, Andy Murray, Nikolay Davydenko and Robin Soderling pose in front of a London Bus in 2009. Photo: Julian Finney/Getty Images.

 The eight players with former British Prime Minister David Cameron [fourth from left] inside 10 Downing Street in London in 2010. Photo: LEON NEAL/AFP via Getty Images. 
 The players with former ATP Executive Chairman & President Chris Kermode [centre] in London in 2014. Photo: Julian Finney/Getty Images. 
 [L-R] John Isner, Kei Nishikori, Dominic Thiem, Novak Djokovic, Marin Cilic, Roger Federer, Kevin Anderson and Alexander Zverev in London in 2018. Photo: Clive Brunskill/Getty Images. 
 [L-R] Andrey Rublev, Alexander Zverev. Matteo Berrettini, Novak Djokovic, Daniil Medvedev, Stefanos Tsitsipas, Casper Ruud and Hubert Hurkacz in Turin in 2021. Photo: Clive Brunskill/Getty Images for ATP. 
 [L-R] Holger Rune, Stefanos Tsitsipas, Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz, Novak Djokovic, Daniil Medvedev, Andrey Rublev and Alexander Zverev in Turin in 2023. Photo: Clive Brunskill/Getty Images. 
 [Clockwise] Alexander Zverev, Carlos Alcaraz, Casper Ruud, Andrey Rublev, Alex de Minaur, Taylor Fritz, Daniil Medvedev and Jannik Sinner in Turin in 2024. Photo: John Russo/ATP Tour. 
 [L-R] Taylor Fritz, Carlos Alcaraz, Alex de Minaur, Alexander Zverev, Jannik Sinner and Ben Shelton in Turin in 2025. Photo: Clive Brunskill/Getty Images.
